description: Register arriving guests; take the deposit authorization; encode key cards; check guests out and settle folios
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 16 arrivals a day, most between 3 p.m. and midnight; a guest who cannot get a key late at night is stranded; walk-in guests go to the next exit; OTA reviews follow within days
manual_workaround: Printed arrivals list from the night audit; paper registration cards; key cards encoded from the lock software, which runs on the back office PC without the PMS; deposits on the terminals in standalone mode
dependent_third_parties: PMS vendor; door lock vendor; internet service provider; MSP
dependent_people_or_facilities: Front Desk Clerks; Night Auditor; front office

description: Take phone and walk-in reservations; receive booking engine and OTA reservations through the channel manager; publish rates
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: When the channel manager stops, OTAs keep selling rooms that are already sold, which leads to overbooking and walked guests; lost reservations cannot be rebuilt without the PMS
manual_workaround: Close inventory directly in the 3 OTA extranets; take phone bookings on paper with name and phone only (never card numbers) and send a pay-by-link once restored; freeze rates in the PMS
dependent_third_parties: PMS vendor; 3 OTAs; dynamic pricing tool vendor; internet service provider

business_process: Card payments, deposits, and no-show charges
description: Card-present payments on the P2PE terminals; keyed phone and no-show charges; OTA virtual card charges; booking engine prepayments; refunds
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 38 card transactions a day (about $2,800); deposits are needed at check-in; payments cannot be taken any other way without breaking card data rules
manual_workaround: Terminals in standalone mode through the gateway; collect balances at check-out; hold no-show charges until restored; never write card numbers on paper
dependent_third_parties: Payment gateway and P2PE solution provider; acquirer; PMS vendor; internet service provider

description: Close the business day; post room and tax charges; produce the guest register, arrivals list, and daily reports
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The register must be kept in chronological order and be available to the state lodging division at any time (Fla. Stat. 509.101(2)); one missed audit can be rerun the next night
manual_workaround: Paper register sheet for the night; rerun the audit once the PMS is back

description: Assign rooms to clean; mark rooms clean, dirty, or out of order; report maintenance issues
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Clean rooms cannot be sold until marked ready; about 27 occupied rooms turn or are serviced each day
manual_workaround: Printed room list and a paper status board at the front desk; radios between housekeeping and the desk
dependent_people_or_facilities: Head Housekeeper; Housekeeper and Laundry Attendant

description: Set up crew accounts; receive crew rosters; bill crew companies by card or by invoice; follow up on receivables
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Crews are about 30% of room-nights; billing can wait a few days but crew clients expect accurate weekly folios
manual_workaround: Post charges to folios; bill once restored; crews settle at check-out if needed
dependent_third_parties: PMS vendor; payment gateway; productivity suite vendor; crew companies

business_process: Guest Wi-Fi, lobby market, and guest services
description: Guest internet access; lobby market sales; coin laundry; wake-up calls and guest requests
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Crew members and business travelers expect Wi-Fi and complain in reviews when it fails; lobby market sales are small
manual_workaround: Post market sales to rooms or use the terminals in standalone mode; apologize and offer a fee credit for Wi-Fi outages
dependent_third_parties: Internet service provider; MSP; PMS vendor

description: Monthly bookkeeping; biweekly payroll; monthly Florida sales and tourist development tax returns
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; tax returns are monthly; a few days of delay is tolerable
manual_workaround: Payroll service repeats the prior payroll; bookkeeper works from bank and gateway portals
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS vendor; payroll service; contracted bookkeeper
